identified_issues: Proxy observation conflated with underlying physical system state (Aperture jurisdiction defect)
Premature database state transition to READY prior to storage commit acknowledgement
Downstream completion invoice generated against a non-existent artifact (unauthorized consequential billing action)
Unhandled storage backend worker crash masked behind static HTTP 200 API response template
evidence: GET /api/v2/transforms/task_991/status returned HTTP 200 with task_status 'READY' and download_url '/api/v2/transforms/task_991/artifacts/archive.zip'
Storage backend worker crashed due to disk exhaustion at block 4,096 while writing archive.zip
Artifact storage bucket contains no file named archive.zip for task_991
Database record transitioned to READY prior to receiving physical storage persistence acknowledgement
Workflow orchestrator marked the step as SUCCESS and issued an ungrounded billing invoice
recommended_action: Revoke and void the premature completion invoice immediately. Reclassify task_991 as FAILED. Refactor orchestrator and transform service to enforce strict two-phase commit verification, conditioning any READY state transition and downstream billing emission on authenticated storage receipt acknowledgement.
